title: Binary and hexadecimal output of hash
summary: The binary parameter of hash changes the return representation; SHA-256 defaults to 64 hex characters and the original digest is 32 bytes.
detail: Base64 encoding the default output will encode the ASCII hexadecimal text, resulting in a different result than the encoded original digest.
boundary: The two representations can only be compared byte-by-byte after converting back the same bytes.
relevance: When checking the check string, it can locate the situation where the digest algorithm is the same but the serialization method is different.
